hero.title: Aisti Aalto®.
hero.lede: Foam-formed natural wood fibre. Absorption Class A, two formats, two thicknesses, three edge profiles. Fits standard T-grid ceilings or mounts directly with adhesive. Available on request.

conscious.body: At its core, Aisti Aalto is a bio-based acoustic absorber built to perform at scale — not a compromise material, a genuine alternative. The fibre is chemi-thermomechanical spruce pulp from certified Finnish forests, produced without toxic substances, with no plastic or synthetic binders and no mineral wool. At 1.8 kg/m² it is light to handle and light on the structure, and it carries no green premium — the performance argument does not cost extra.

thickness.note: 20 mm and 40 mm, both in either format. Mounting is set by the edge profile, not the thickness.

edge_types.title: Explore our edge types
edge_types.body: Aisti Aalto tiles are available in three edge profiles — A, B, and E — each offering a distinct aesthetic and installation method to suit your project.

technology.body_p1: It starts as spruce. The fibres are pulped, mixed with water and a foaming agent, then formed in foam rather than pressed — millions of tiny bubbles distribute the fibre evenly and leave an open, porous structure that absorbs sound across a wide frequency range. As it dries, natural hydrogen bonds hold that structure together, so the tile needs no plastic or synthetic binders.
technology.body_p2: Fire protection sits in the material, not in a coating. A potassium-based salt treatment reacts to heat and forms a protective ceramic layer on the surface of the tile — a barrier that shields the wood fibres beneath and slows flame spread, which is what carries the B-s1,d0 classification. The solution is patented and unique to Aisti. At end of life the core goes back to the factory to be pulped and formed again. Made in Finland.
technology.body_p3: In the room, that translates to less reverberation and background noise — speech carries more clearly, conversations feel more natural, and the space simply feels calmer to be in.

partner.body: Aisti represents Finnish ingenuity, innovation and responsibility — working to become the leading provider of exceptionally sustainable acoustic products that are safe and sound for people and the environment, freeing the industry from mineral wool and fossil-based materials one ceiling at a time.

co2.disclaimer: Calculations are based on manufacturers' EPD — compared with stone wool. Aisti Aalto 20 mm vs Rockfon Sonar 20mm. Aisti figures: EPD Hub HUB-5632 (Aisti Corporation Oy, published 06.03.2026) — lifecycle emissions is GWP-fossil summed across A1-C4; stored CO₂ is GWP-biogenic at A1-A3 (factory gate, before any end-of-life release). Rockfon figure from its public Sonar 20mm datasheet.
